security_implications: Secret key is directly routed to hmac_core; any external corruption or observation of secret_key compromises HMAC. The SHA engine's digest can be overwritten via digest_sw/digest_sw_we; if this path is not strictly gated, an attacker can replace the true HMAC output. Wipe inputs are connected but triggering logic is elsewhere; failure to assert them after use leaves secret material in the SHA engine. The bus integrity error is hardwired to alert[0]; an unhandled integrity error could go undetected if the alert is not propagated. Key length is unbounded, potentially allowing weak keying. Alert test logic could be abused to subvert reliability of error reporting.
